scope: Decorative city covers only; not real venue photography. Homepage search hero preserved.
promptStyle: Premium photorealistic travel editorial landscape, one coherent scene, horizontal 3:2, natural refined colors, soft daylight, crisp realistic detail, balanced crop. No text, borders, logos, watermark or collage. Not a documentary or business photo.

subjects.istanbul: Ortaköy mosque, Bosphorus bridge, white ferry and seagulls in late afternoon.
subjects.antalya: Turquoise Konyaaltı beach, Mediterranean sea and mountains.
subjects.cappadocia: Göreme fairy chimneys and restrained hot-air balloons at sunrise.
subjects.ankara: Anıtkabir colonnade and limestone plaza in afternoon light.
subjects.izmir: Alaçatı cobblestone street, stone houses, blue shutters and bougainvillea.
subjects.mugla: Bodrum/Yalıkavak marina, yachts, white coastal homes and blue bay.
subjects.aydin: Kuşadası Güvercinada-inspired island castle, causeway and olive branches.
subjects.denizli: Pamukkale white travertine terraces and pale blue pools.
subjects.trabzon: Sümela-inspired cliff monastery in a green misty valley.
subjects.konya: Mevlana-inspired green dome and historic courtyard.
subjects.bursa: Uludağ snowy slopes, fir trees and cable car in winter sunlight.
subjects.gaziantep: Restrained documentary-style coppersmith bazaar scene; weathered limestone, copperware, ordinary distant shoppers, soft overcast light, neutral earth tones. No food collage or cinematic grading. Decorative generated scene, not a documented location photo.

output: 640px and 1536px WebP, quality 80; original generated PNGs retained outside repository.
